name: Habit
q: A habit at three lasts to eighty

Starve the habit you want to lose
It's never too late to plant a good habit
Coax a habit downstairs, don't throw it out
First we make habits, then habits make us
Chains of habit grow too strong to break
Our life is but a mass of habits
One nail drives out another; habit is overcome by habit
Habit works more steadily than reason
Early habits make all the difference
Custom is the chief magistrate of life
